answer: Every agent must lock a slashable bond before it can vote or get paid. A sybil farm therefore needs the same capital per fake identity as an honest agent stakes, so a thousand puppets cost as much as a thousand real operators. One cheating identity caught by peer attestation loses its whole stake, like one rotten corner of an orchard spoiling the harvest. Reputation cannot be transferred, so a fresh sable coat of new keys earns no trust, and when many look-alike accounts appear at once their copper deposits are seized together.
